title: Body in 7 Days? Pure Chalk! 💪 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | English Cartoon Comedy
description:
Ever heard of a powder that gives you a body in just 7 days? The whole colony is ready to believe it, and the gang's first reaction is a pure wah-wah moment. Chhotu and Bablu buy a shiny tin of Power Powder, Munni is totally convinced it works, and Kusum Dadi has her own strong opinions on protein. Watch the gang chase the seller through lanes, bazaars and one very wobbly rooftop. The lesson: a shortcut to a body is usually just chalk dust in a fancy tin, so think twice before you believe the ads. Subscribe to Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony for a new episode every week!
